column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the text with CR removed
# v0.2.0 (commit fcb3f90, tag object b414329) is the newest published build; v0.1.0 (206ed6c) is the
# other. The repo publishes v* releases only, no dev pre-release, and no predecessor repo shipped
# this mod. v0.2.0 pinned core c2d7914. src/config.cpp, src/config.h, src/config_sanitize.h and
# src/logging.h are byte for byte the same at v0.2.0 and at a3d911b, the commit the reader was frozen
# at, and every core source either reader compiles holds the same bytes at c2d7914 and at the
# current pin, so comparison 1 finds no difference.
# Neither release ZIP nor launcher-manifest.json shipped or seeded a HeadTracking.ini: each build's
# first start wrote it from kDefaultIniText in src/config.cpp. Those texts, extracted once, are the
# first-run inputs. The repo's HeadTracking.ini has five committed versions up to v0.2.0, each an
# input as git stores it (LF); 4625b25 is v0.1.0's first-run text and 0295f07 v0.2.0's.
